answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 36 POA per identity, released only after 10 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 180 fakes must lock 6480 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. The signal keeps the gate honest, the atlas keeps the farm poor, and the pigment keeps the honest agent paid.
